chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent an army to Khas'aam. When they overcame them, they exempted themselves by prostration. Some of them were killed, and that reached the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). So he said: 'Give to the inheritors half the blood-money for their prayer.'
And the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Indeed, I am free from every Muslim who lodges with a polytheist in the abode of war.'

key_terms.السُّجُود: Prostration, used here as a means of exemption
key_terms.دَارِ الْحَرْب: Abode of war, referring to the battlefield or territory of non-Muslims

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on Muslims who stay with polytheists in the battlefield according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the legal status of the Khas'aam tribe, whose partial adherence to Islam (indicated by prayer) resulted in a half-blood-money (diya) ruling rather than full execution, highlighting the Shia emphasis on precise criteria for combatant status. The Prophet’s declaration of disavowal from Muslims lodging with polytheists in dar al-harb underscores the principle of distinct communal identity and political allegiance during wartime, a key concept in Shia jurisprudence for determining the validity of prayers and treaties.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> sent an army to Khas’am. So when they overcame them, they exempted themselves by (performing) the Prostration. So some of them were killed, and (the news of) that reach the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Give to the inheritors half the compensation due to their Prayer’.
And the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Indeed! I<sup>saww</sup> disavow from every Muslim who lodges with a Polytheist in the battlefield’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father, from af-Nawfafiy from af-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that once, the Messenger of Allah dispatched an army against the KhatlTam. When this army was overpowered by the enemy they sought protection by performing prostration. Certain ones among them were killed. When the news reached the Holy Prophet he said, ‘You must pay half of the amount of compensation for their lives because of their prayer.’
The Holy Prophet said, ‘I certainly denounce one who is a Muslim and yet goes to reside in the war zone with the pagans.’”
